I'm the person behind Fruita Tech Wizard, and I live right here in Fruita.

My day job is [Dynamodal](https://www.dynamodal.com/), where I do data, AI, and energy analysis work for consulting teams.
I enjoy that work, and I also wanted to do something for my own community, so I started FTW to offer friendly, personal tech help to my neighbors and local businesses.

I've always been the go-to tech person for family, friends, and coworkers.
I studied physics and electrical engineering at the Colorado School of Mines, worked a few years in the Alaskan oil fields, and have spent the last couple of decades working with computers, data, and all the tech in between.
I love explaining things in plain English and helping people feel more confident with their technology.

When I'm not working, I'm usually biking, running, or exploring the trails and rivers around Fruita.

### Why FTW? {#why-ftw}

If you've spent any time in Fruita, you've probably seen the [WTF stickers](https://fruita.com/wtf-welcome-to-fruita/).
Officially it stands for "Welcome to Fruita."
Unofficially... well, you know.
(It even [stirred up a little controversy](https://www.westword.com/opinion/wtf-fruita-controversial-slogan-wears-out-its-welcome-5826454/).)

FTW is my nod to those stickers.
It stands for Fruita Tech Wizard, and also "For The Win," which is what I hope you'll feel once your tech is working again.
And the dino on a bike?
That's Fruita: dinosaurs and bikes.
